sources.title: Taxation Administration Act 1953
sources.fact: TPAR and no-ABN reporting pathways, periods and authorities must be kept distinct and rechecked against the current compilation. Read 28 October 2026 in compilation C2026C00468 (compilation 227, in force from 1 October 2026): its amending Acts changed s 396-55 table items 3 and 15 only to use the defined term real property, and did not amend table items 11 to 14, s 12-190 or Division 405.
